{{DISPLAYTITLE:Dialogue}}

== Where to do I find text? ==

Most dialogue and cutscene text is usually found in the BattleRes folder, or the System folder. When you dump the game, check the _English folder. Usually that contains all edited text.
All files can be opened with any text editor (such as Notepad). If the text appears corrupt, try using a different encoder with programs like VSC or Notepad++. FPAN uses Shift JIS encoding.

{| class="wikitable"
|-

|-
| Win Quotes ||  <code>BattleRes\win_mes\script</code>
|-
| Arcade / Boss Rush Dialogue ||  <code>BattleRes\talk\script</code>
|-
| Chronicle Mode (UNICLR) ||  <code>BattleRes\talk\script\99story</code>
|-
| Intros / Outros (MBTL) ||<code>System\str_jp\stringfile_battlevoice.csv</code>
